items.text: With a spike in COVID cases across the country, testing sites & hospitals in our community are overwhelmed.  Please play your part in protecting your community by getting vaccinated TODAY. 💉

🧵 As Chair of the General Farm Commodities & Risk Management Subcommittee, I’m excited to see all 14 counties in NW & Central Illinois are eligible for @usdaRMA’s new Post Application Coverage Endorsement.

Having reliable, affordable health insurance is more important than ever during the COVID19 pandemic.

Visit https://t.co/lgS4ZUOCGG to #GetCovered before the deadline ends TOMORROW, Jan. 15th.

Community centers are a vital resource of our cities, counties and towns.

Today, I met with local leaders at Graham Medical Clinic to talk about ways we can make our communities stronger — like a Rural Community Wellness Center in Knox County. https://t.co/QEOiJq8SJc

Prescription drug prices have been too high for far too long. We must take action to ensure every American can access the medications they need without breaking the bank. That means finally allowing Medicare to negotiate prescription drug prices. #SOTU

Today marks the 12th anniversary of the historic passage of the #AffordableCareAct.

Thanks to this law, MILLIONS more Americans have access to health coverage. Let's keep building on this progress to ensure everyone has access to affordable, quality health care. https://t.co/T6nzOyAFbR

Today, @POTUS is expected to eliminate a loophole that has stopped millions from getting healthcare coverage. 

By fixing the "family glitch", President Biden will expand coverage to nearly 200,000 people and lower insurance costs for up to 5M Americans. https://t.co/wNcHtmLKeA

Hello, Northwest & Central Illinois! 

Follow me as I visit @WIUQuadCities, @cityofgalesburg's Sanitary District Wastewater Treatment Plant & @CityofPeoria_IL’s former Harrison School to meet with local officials & present federal funds I secured for community projects. https://t.co/idyuw0QFF4

Second stop: Galesburg Sanitary District’s Wastewater Treatment Plant! 

I had a great Cheri on Shift learning more about the water treatment process and had the pleasure of presenting $1.2M in federal funds to upgrade the facility — thank you all for your hospitality! https://t.co/q6hfRTSdkT

Healthcare workers courageously provide sexual and reproductive healthcare in the face of unrelenting threats, violence and harassment. 

That’s why I’m proud to cosponsor the #HealthcareProvidersSafetyAct to ensure providers get the security they need and deserve. https://t.co/5ScWd6Qhh6

One week from today is the Illinois Primary. I encourage everyone to exercise their constitutional right and vote - Let your voice be heard!
 https://t.co/Frdu8O7Zvo

Today is the sixth anniversary of the Whole Woman’s Health v. Hellerstedt which reaffirmed the freedom to make your own healthcare decisions.

Last Friday, #SCOTUS restricted that freedom. As we enter a Post-Roe era, our fight is FAR from over.

Wishing @POTUS a quick recovery! I'm glad to hear his symptoms are mild. 

Let this serve as a reminder that this pandemic is far from over. If you haven't been vaccinated or boosted, I highly encourage you to do so to keep yourself and your loved ones safe.

Telehealth services are a lifeline for patients -- particularly those in rural areas.

We just passed bipartisan legislation to keep these services available to folks enrolled in Medicare after the current public health emergency ends. https://t.co/Bm46hNYGrC

For 57 years, Medicaid and Medicare have helped protect the health and well-being of millions of Americans. As we celebrate today's anniversary, let's pledge to continue to support these vital programs and fight to provide affordable, quality health care to everyone. https://t.co/ye1i8s8EyL
.@HHSGov, @USDOL and @USTreasury made it clear - contraceptive coverage is GUARANTEED at no additional cost under the Affordable Care Act regardless of what state you live in. https://t.co/JXUEXKpfTy

In 3 DAYS, the House will vote on HISTORIC legislation to LOWER health care and prescription drug costs for patients and their families. This bill is a game-changer for folks who’ve had to ration or skip life-saving medications due to high costs.
The Inflation Reduction Act will LOWER prescription drug costs and cap out-of-pocket costs to $2,000 annually - saving patients an average of $900 per year! https://t.co/6vT2SGEfMA

TODAY, the House will vote on the #InflationReductionAct and send it to @POTUS' desk to sign into law! Together we will make history by lowering healthcare prices, energy costs, and the national deficit while ensuring corporations pay their share. https://t.co/JaiAdQQOoy

With the #InflationReductionAct now the law of the land, a family in Northwest & Central Illinois with two adults, two children and a household income of $75,000 could SAVE $2,832 on their health care premiums next year!

Second stop @RosecranceNews in Freeport!

I’m thrilled to deliver $300,000 to help build a new outpatient behavioral health care clinic at Rosecrance in Freeport. By expanding access to care, folks in rural areas will now get the treatment they need! https://t.co/CzYeLtgRvJ

September is National Suicide Prevention Month - a time to educate ourselves on a topic that affects anyone regardless of age, gender or background. If you or someone you know is experiencing a mental health crisis, CALL or TEXT 988 for help. https://t.co/HgyxuyHzAA

Paperwork shouldn't delay Illinois seniors from getting diabetes meds, MRI scans or other care they need.

Today, I voted for the Improving Seniors' Timely Access to Care Act to reduce #PriorAuth paperwork for our doctors, streamline care & improve health outcomes for seniors. https://t.co/INEwNgcnUL

Last year, nearly 108,000 Americans lost their lives to drug overdoses. It’s a record we don’t want to break. If you or someone you know is struggling with a mental health or substance use disorder, remember that recovery is possible. #CongressGoesPurple https://t.co/FEtaeiLQZp

This evening, I was proud to stand by my colleagues for #CongressGoesPurple to celebrate Recovery Month. Substance abuse and mental health disorders can affect us all, so let's work together to support those in recovery. https://t.co/YoSmdA9kdZ
